snippet.title: BACKFIRE - PC Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist BACKFIRE now on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3392590/BACKFIRE/?beta=0

BACKFIRE was originally released in 2019 as a premium mobile game. 

BACKFIRE is a fast paced arcade shooter with a sinister twist... your weapons fire backwards. Descend into a cursed arcade machine, engage in intense combat, and die to demented bosses. Upgrade your power after each attempt until you are strong enough to prevail. 

This summer BACKFIRE is being reborn on PC.
